caption:
Most owners blame their marketing when leads go cold.

The real gap is memory.

Pull your last 20 leads. Count how many got a genuine second follow-up beyond the first reply.

If it's under half, the ad did its job. Your business didn't do its.

A free pocket CRM logs every lead the moment it lands and reminds you when to follow up.

DM TOOLS

#leadfollowup #servicebusiness #smallbusinessmarketing #crmforcontractors #speedtolead
rationale: Fills the under-served Contrarian/POV slot with a fresh reframe (memory/systems gap, not ad spend) distinct from every prior reframe shipped, using the reel format research shows still wins reach for cold-audience POV content.
